title: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo/Achievements
text:
There are 12 achievements for the Xbox 360 worth .

|-
| File:SPF2T Alternative Lifestyles.jpg||Alternative Lifestyles || Complete Y or Z Modes on Hard or Expert Difficulty. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Chain of Jewels.jpg||Chain of Jewels… || Perform a 7 chain combo in X or X’ mode. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Chain, Chain, Chain.jpg||Chain, Chain, Chain, || Perform a 5 chain combo in X or X’ mode. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Classic Battle Master.jpg||Classic Battle Master || Complete X Arcade Mode on Hard or Expert Difficulty. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Get Your Feet Wet.jpg||Get Your Feet Wet || Win three Ranked Matches of X or X’ Mode. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Meeting People is Easy.jpg||Meeting People is Easy || You joined or hosted a 4 person Player Match. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Modern Battle Master.jpg||Modern Battle Master || Complete X’ Arcade Mode on Hard or Expert Difficulty. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Mother Lode.jpg||Mother Lode || Break a Power Gem size 25 or larger. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Playing to Win.jpg||Playing to Win || Win 20 Ranked Matches in X’ mode. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Power Made Flesh.jpg||Power Made Flesh || Play as Akuma in any mode. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T Quarter Miser.jpg||Quarter Miser || Complete the game in any mode without continuing. || 
|-
| File:SPF2T The Longest Journey.jpg||The Longest Journey || Complete X’ Mode on Hard or Expert Mode using only Dan. || 
|}

Category:Xbox 360 achievements
